why: Local sideload 2026-10-27: 'fill every signed by placeholder with Jane Doe' came back as one block edit whose Title line erased the blank ('Title: [__]' -> 'Title: '). splitMultilineFieldEdits turns it into one card per line, and the Title card would wipe the placeholder, so the field reads as deliberately empty and the review's unfilled-placeholder check no longer sees it. normalizeProposals drops a card that turns a blank into nothing (erasesBlank). The unrequested 'for and on behalf of Sony Corp' card survives: no code rule can tell an unrequested value from a wanted one (CLAUDE.md, the SCOPE rule). expect.edits is the backend's raw output; expect.normalized is extractEditBlocks(prose).blocks.
